0022600205.text: The Washington Wizards (4-6, 2-4 on the road) are 2nd in the Southeast, 2.5 games back, and 8th in the East, entering their 11th game of the season on a three-game losing streak. The Detroit Pistons (6-2, 4-1 on the road) lead the Central and sit 3rd in the East after a loss in their most recent game. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, while Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Washington lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 117-95 defeat in Washington on March 19, 2026.
